description: Commands every verifier must refuse with exactly the listed code.
howToRun: For each vector: build the verifier state named by `verifier` from keys.json, set its clock to `now` and its recorded nonces to `seenNonces`, then verify the bytes of `bodyHex`. The result must be `expect` exactly (ok, or the first failing error code in §10 order).

vectors.description: Body of 8193 bytes: refused before parsing.
Body of exactly 8192 bytes passes the size check (and then fails on the name).
Trailing comma inside the payload object.
A second value after the object.
Escaped lone high surrogate \ud800 (not a Unicode scalar value).
Invalid UTF-8 sequence C3 28 inside the display name.
Body starts with a UTF-8 byte order mark.
Nesting depth 17 (> 16) inside an unknown payload member.

Top-level "operation" repeated with the same value.

"nonce" and "\u006eonce" are the same member name after unescaping.
Protocol identifier compared byte for byte (lowercase is unknown).
